interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to the crosswalk to increase driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Marked Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install a dedicated bike lane to provide separation between cyclists and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway Re-striping
interventions.description: Apply clear lane markings to define travel lanes and improve driver predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and reclaim space for pedestrian or bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway on the roadway or adjacent to the construction site to maintain pedestrian continuity.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to allow pedestrians to safely cross to the open side of the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Paving
interventions.description: Widen and properly pave the walkway on the left side to provide a consistent and safe pedestrian facility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and widen the sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards and provide a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve safety and security along the walkway, especially near the large trees and temporary structures.

interventions.title: Walkway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded pavement on the left to provide a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Protected Shared-Use Path
interventions.description: Install a physical buffer, such as a planted strip or bollards, to clearly separate the path from the roadway and improve safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental-style markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert the existing painted bike lane into a protected lane using bollards or a raised curb to prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the right side of the roadway to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for all road users, particularly pedestrians using the walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Enhancements
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'Pedestrian Crossing' signage and curb ramps at the existing marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and ensure a clear walking path free from tree obstructions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the walkway to eliminate cracks and vegetation growth, ensuring a smooth and accessible path.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure that temporary signage and maintenance equipment are placed in the buffer zone rather than obstructing the clear walking width.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures such as lane narrowing or speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this unprotected environment.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a standard-width concrete sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide dedicated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate warning signage to facilitate safe crossing to the institutional site.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at the approaching intersection to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level surface and clear all construction debris and dirt from the walkway.

interventions.title: Managed Construction Access
interventions.description: Install clear signage and pavement markings at the construction entrance to alert drivers to pedestrians and define the walkway path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and install a planting strip or physical barrier to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes and repurpose excess pavement to slow vehicle speeds and shorten pedestrian crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to alert drivers to the midblock crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk with a buffer from the roadway to provide safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale and roadway lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Relocate construction equipment and fencing to maintain a clear, continuous walking path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: If this is a transit or park access point, install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and curb ramps.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked midblock crossing with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the road to ensure pedestrian continuity on both sides.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Introduce traffic calming such as speed humps or raised crossings to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight segment.

interventions.title: Temporary Protected Walkway
interventions.description: During construction, provide a temporary water-filled or concrete barrier to create a protected path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Widening
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a safe, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve safety.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement lane narrowing or speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide stretch of road.

interventions.title: Construct Permanent Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved concrete sidewalk to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint or thermoplastic to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the painted buffer and flexible bollards with permanent concrete curb extensions to physically prevent illegal parking and shorten crossing distances.
